title: Musunuri Nayaks and Recherla Velamas
quote: Vimochanodyamam: first organised resistance to Muslim rule in Andhra

items.what: Kapaya helps **Hasan Gangu** found Bahmani kingdom
==**Bhimavaram**==: Anapota kills Kapaya; Musunuri line ends

boxes.title: Kapaya vs Bahmanis
items: Son **Vinayaka Deva** burnt alive by **Muhammad Shah I** (**1361**/**1362**)
Allied with **Bukka I**; sought **Firoz Shah Tughlaq**

boxes.title: Recherla Velamas (1325-1475)
head: Ruler
Contribution
rows: ==Founder of independent kingdom==; freed **Nalgonda, Mahabubnagar**; killed by **Jallipalli** chiefs

boxes.title: Velama alliances
head: Power
Relation
rows: **Mahmud Gawan** crushed Telangana revolts with Velama help
Helped invade Vijayanagara after **Deva Raya II**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: "First" Andhra Suratrana = **Kapaya**; with Anavema in options → **Anavema Reddi**
⚠ Bhimavaram: PYQ key says **Reddis** beat Velamas; learn it as Velama vs Musunuri
⚠ Errana's patron per APPSC keys: **Prolaya Vema Reddi**
**Sultan Quli Qutb Shah** annexed Rachakonda, Devarakonda
